svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. Cut 70 x 70 mm softwood to 857 mm, square both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each leg has an outside corner, where its end face (toward the end of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bench) meets its side face (toward the front or back).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End face: two 9 mm holes 12.5 mm from the centre toward the outside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corner, 40 and 100 mm down from the top (long apron); two 9 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes on the centre line, 100 and 130 mm up from the foot (low rail).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side face: two 9 mm holes 12.5 mm from the centre toward the outside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corner, 20 and 70 mm down from the top (end apron).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill all six square to the face, right through, in a drill stand.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: bore 12 mm, 60 deep, on the centre; tap in the M10 T-nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round or chamfer every outside edge about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 9 mm rod passes each hole square; the leg stands upright.
